test_gtn_equal: test gtn.equal to compare two graphs for structural and label equality
test_gtn_isomorphic: test gtn.isomorphic to check if two graphs are structurally equivalent
test_gtn_loadtxt: test gtn.loadtxt to load a graph from a text file format
test_gtn_savetxt: test gtn.savetxt to save a graph to a text file format
test_gtn_loadsave: test gtn.save and gtn.load to serialize and deserialize graphs to a binary file
